name: M'ONDUNIQ Laser-IQ Crème Réparatrice soothing and capillary-strengthening cream
shortDescription: Mondoceutical regenerating cream for sensitive skin and skin prone to couperose and telangiectasia, with date seed extract and stabilised vitamin C. Available in 50 and 150 ml sizes.
description:
The M'ONDUNIQ soothing and capillary-strengthening hydrating, replenishing cream is a professional mondoceutical product developed specifically for the targeted care of sensitive skin with increased vascular reactivity, skin with couperose and skin prone to telangiectasia. Its innovative MONDOCEUTICSALS™ technology uses advanced active ingredients that support the skin's natural regeneration, reduce the appearance of diffuse redness and help restore skin comfort.

Professional aesthetic treatments – especially Q-switched ND:YAG laser Carbon Peeling, IPL photorejuvenation, cold plasma, microneedling, microneedling radiofrequency and other skin-renewal procedures – can temporarily increase the skin's vascular reactivity and sensitivity. That is why proper soothing and barrier-strengthening aftercare is one of the most important elements of post-treatment regeneration.

The formula contains date seed extract, stabilised vitamin C and a plant complex of six herbs. The natural polyphenols and antioxidants of date seed help reduce oxidative stress and support the calming of irritated skin. Stabilised vitamin C and the herbal complex help support the physiological function of microcirculation and help improve a more even appearance of the skin.

Adequate hydration and support of the skin's protective barrier are essential during post-treatment regeneration. The formula helps reduce transepidermal water loss (TEWL) and supports the skin's natural defence functions.

Its light, fast-absorbing texture does not burden sensitive skin, making it an ideal choice for finishing professional treatments as well as for clients' regenerating home skincare routines.

The success of Carbon Peeling and other laser skin-renewal treatments is not determined solely by the laser technology itself. Post-treatment skincare and a proper home protocol play at least as important a role in regeneration and in preserving the results achieved over the long term. That is why the M'ONDUNIQ Soothing and Capillary-Strengthening Cream is an integral part of the LaserIQ treatment protocol. Its aim is to support the skin's natural regeneration, reduce temporary post-treatment redness, enhance skin comfort and, with its antioxidant active ingredients, help protect regenerating skin. It is especially recommended for clients who show increased skin reactivity, diffuse redness or a tendency to telangiectasia during Carbon Peeling.

The M'ONDUNIQ Soothing and Capillary-Strengthening Cream can be used as a professional finishing product after any treatment where the primary goal is to calm the skin, support regeneration and restore skin comfort as quickly as possible. It is especially recommended after Q-switched ND:YAG Carbon Peeling treatments, after IPL photorejuvenation, for finishing cold plasma treatments, in the regeneration phase of microneedling treatments, after microneedling radiofrequency treatments, after enzymatic exfoliation, and in professional treatment protocols for sensitive skin, skin with couperose and skin with increased vascular reactivity.

Sizes: 50 ml, 150 ml.
